title: 2019 Panini Prestige #215 Taylor Rapp Los Angeles Rams Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019 Panini Prestige sports trading card features Los Angeles Rams player Taylor Rapp, with card number 215. It is a part of the base set and also considered a rookie card. The card is from the National Football League (NFL) and manufactured by Panini. 

The card is perfect for collectors who are fans of football and the Los Angeles Rams. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and would make a fantastic gift. The card is not autographed and is a part of the 2019 season.
